title: source-gates reads README.md and LICENSE, but the push trigger paths omit both, so a push touching only those gets no push-triggered run
description:
Reported by opum-agent under OPAG-432 AC3 (2026-09-25), from its fleet audit tooling/fleet-sweep/bin/paths-coverage-audit.mjs (opum-ai/opum-agent#1030). The audit asks whether a required job's push paths filter covers every file the job reads. Same class as QCLI-376, whose fix (opum-ai/quest-cli#283, 9871531) did not cover this. opum-agent ran the controls by ref: at 4bd161a (9871531's parent) the audit lists QCLI-376's five files plus README.md; at 9871531 it lists README.md only.

VERIFIED HERE at origin/dev 0b26cf7, by git show, not taken from the relay. source-gates runs scripts/qualification/prepublish.mjs, which always runs the package_contents_and_provenance gate (bun run check:packages, i.e. scripts/check-package-artifacts.mjs). That script:
(1) README.md, CONTENT gate. It extracts package/README.md from the packed root tarball (line 272) and fails on version-claim marker errors or a version token outside a claim region (lines 286-353).
(2) LICENSE, PRESENCE gate only, found here and NOT in the audit's output. The root pack contents must be exactly LICENSE, README.md, bin/quest.cjs and package.json (line 88), so deleting or renaming the root LICENSE fails the gate. package.json files lists README.md and LICENSE.
.github/workflows/prepublication-qualification.yml push paths list neither README.md nor LICENSE. The pull_request trigger is unfiltered, so a PR still gets one source-gates row. What is lost is the push-triggered run on dev, and with it the dev-SHA source-gates row a fast-forward promotion needs before a PR exists (see the CLAUDE.md profile section on source-gates and ABSENT).

NOT MEASURED: whether the audit reads presence-only dependencies such as LICENSE at all. If it does not, it has a second blind spot, worth reporting to opum-agent when this lands.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The push trigger paths in prepublication-qualification.yml include README.md and LICENSE, or the task records a written reason for leaving either out
A re-run of opum-agent paths-coverage-audit.mjs against the fixing ref reports no omission for quest-cli, cited with its ref and output
opum-agent is told whether its audit reads presence-only dependencies such as LICENSE, with the LICENSE case as the test

plan: 1. Verify the gap at the current dev head by reading the workflow paths and the gate script reads.
2. Add README.md and LICENSE to the push paths, annotated in the file existing style.
3. Fetch opum-agent paths-coverage-audit.mjs and read it to answer the presence-only question with the LICENSE case (AC 3).
4. Run that audit against the fixing ref and capture ref plus output for AC 2.
5. Gates: bun run check and lore check.
6. Deliver per opum-sdlc; close in the PR; report the AC 3 answer and AC 2 citation to opum-agent.
implementationNotes:
SESSION HANDOFF and standing state at the opum-workflow 0.10.12 restart wave (opum-agent OPAG-729, 2026-09-29). QCLI-377 is next up; this note is where it stands.

CLAIMED, not started: status In Progress, the plan is recorded above, and no source change has been made yet. The verified cause, re-read at dev head fd91cdd5 by reading the files rather than the record: .github/workflows/prepublication-qualification.yml lists neither README.md nor LICENSE in its push paths (a grep for either returns zero hits in the file), while scripts/check-package-artifacts.mjs genuinely reads both -- LICENSE as a presence gate in the packed-file lists at lines 74 and 88 (the root pack must be exactly LICENSE, README.md, bin/quest.cjs and package.json), and README.md as a content gate through the packed README version-claim assertions from line 272 on. The pull_request trigger is unfiltered, so what is lost is only the push-triggered run on dev, and with it the dev-SHA row a fast-forward promotion needs before a promotion PR exists.

THE FIX (AC 1): add README.md and LICENSE to that push paths list, annotated with this task id in the file existing comment style (compare the QCLI-376 and QCLI-328 blocks already there). No gate change is needed. Worth keeping in view: the feature branch will touch the workflow file, so source-gates will fire twice on its head -- once per trigger -- and the merge to dev will carry both rows.

THE ASK AT THIS TASK BOUNDARY (ACs 2 and 3, both need opum-agent): AC 2 wants opum-agent paths-coverage-audit.mjs re-run against the fixing ref, cited with its ref and output. That tool lives in the opum-agent repository at tooling/fleet-sweep/bin/paths-coverage-audit.mjs and imports ../lib/paths-coverage.mjs and ../lib/fleet.mjs, so fetch the whole tooling/fleet-sweep tree, not the bin file alone. It reads by gh api and mutates nothing. Usage: node bin/paths-coverage-audit.mjs --repo quest-cli --ref <sha>, with --record <file> to capture the bytes read. Two practical traps measured this session: quote any gh api URL containing a question mark (an unquoted ?recursive=1 is glob-expanded by zsh and fails, the same trap this repository profile already records), and read lib/paths-coverage.mjs before trusting a clean result, because AC 3 asks whether the audit even sees presence-only dependencies such as LICENSE -- the LICENSE case is the test. If it cannot, that blind spot is the finding to report back to opum-agent.

WHAT ELSE MOVED AT THIS BOUNDARY, for orientation: QCLI-311 is Done and promoted -- main is fd91cdd5, a fast-forward of dev, the ordinary promotion path.
